overview_description.description: Freedx is a Dubai- and El Salvador–based cryptocurrency exchange platform that enables users to buy, sell, trade, and manage digital assets such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, and other cryptocurrencies. The company positions itself as a next-generation centralized crypto exchange (CEX) focused on combining institutional-grade security with a user-friendly trading experience for both beginner and advanced traders.

about_short_description.short_description: Freedx is a Dubai- and El Salvador–based cryptocurrency exchange platform.

product.name: Freedx Crypto Exchange Platform
product.description: A digital asset trading platform for account-based cryptocurrency transactions, custody, deposits, withdrawals, order management, and market monitoring.

product.name: Spot Trading
product.description: A cryptocurrency spot market for buying and selling digital assets using market and limit orders, real-time charts, and an order book.

product.name: Futures Trading
product.description: A leveraged digital asset derivatives service supporting perpetual futures, isolated margin, take-profit and stop-loss orders, and liquidation management.

product.name: Instant Convert
product.description: A cryptocurrency conversion service for swapping one digital asset for another through a quoted, one-click transaction without using an order book.

product.name: Instant Buy
product.description: A fiat-to-crypto purchase service that lets users buy cryptocurrencies using cards, bank transfers, SEPA, Apple Pay, Samsung Pay, Google Pay, and other payment methods.

product.name: Rewards Hub
product.description: A platform area where users can participate in cryptocurrency campaigns and other activities to receive eligible rewards.
